note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of Hamilton's official straight front render (38 mm case silhouette, listing; bracelet 19.2 mm at the case against 20 mm lug width). House method: modelled brushed case (one body from the traced outline), polished bezel rims with the photo's black insert, crown, applied batons (double at 12), hands and the three-column bracelet; the dial map serves the dial print, the silver rehaut track and the insert.

bezel.note: polished outer rim and inner ring, the black insert between them photo-mapped

dial.note: black dial; the printed silver rehaut track is a cone up to the crystal ring (dial map)

bracelet.note: three brushed columns: outer links (joints 20.9 mm + 9 mm pitch), wide centre link half a row nearer the case (18.0 mm); house curl from the first outer joint

steel_polished.note: house polished steel: bezel, crown, index frames, hands, bevels

steel_brushed.note: house brushed steel: case, lugs, crown guards

review.subtitle: Steel case, black bezel insert, black dial with applied batons, steel bracelet. Front relief GLB.
notes: Built on Hamilton's official 2000 px front render. House method: case, bezel rims, crown, applied batons, hands and the bracelet are modelled; the photo is used only for the dial print, the silver track and the black insert.
The bracelet curls under at both ends, like the other tracker watches. The clasp is left out.
